links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated responses measured by Flesch Reading Ease
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease scores for both ChatGPT-4.0 and ChatGPT-4.0-mini rated content 'very difficult to read', potentially limiting patient accessibility.
links.quote: The Flesch Reading Ease scores for both models indicated that their generated content was “very difficult to read,” potentially limiting patient accessibility.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT-4o and ChatGPT-4o mini on clinical guideline questions and image interpretation for lumbar disc herniation offline with surgeon evaluators, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
